step: boil, chill overnight, whip to a foam
text: The milk is boiled and cooled without stirring in a skin, left in the cold overnight, then beaten to a foam at dawn. The foam is skimmed off and sweetened.

steps.note: The milk is left outdoors overnight to cool, traditionally in the dew, and not stirred.

steps.name: whip
steps.note: The milk is beaten to a foam at dawn.
Nuts and silver leaf are put on top.
